Since many of the parking areas will be locat close to the homes and businesses they serve and since they will be well lit, security for the project residents will be greatly increased.
Traffic safety in the area will also be impacted in a positive manner due to the reduction of crowded on-street parking and the reduction of cars circulating in search of a parking space. The reduced circulation of vehicles will also help reduce air pollution levels.
Paved parking areas will reduce the available vegetation in the area but this is being offset by the additional landscaped open space areas.
j. Adjacent Land Use
Land adjacent to the project area will be effected by project activities. The provision of open space on the south end of the project will provide amenities to areas adjacent to the south end of the project as well as to the project area itself. Rehabilitation activities in the project area may have both positive and negative effects on the adjacent land: On one hand they may cause the sympathetic regeneration of surrounding areas; on the other hand, due to the anticipated rent increases associated with rehabilitation they may exclude low income families, thereby forcing them to be concentrated in adjacent areas. Weighing these possible effects is a speculative task. However, the impact of the project on adjacent land use, it is believed, will tend to be more positive than negative.
